01

Sounds live on your device

No network requests, no account, no data collected. On a plane, in a hotel, or in a room with no signal — it works the same.

Timer, fade, volume and idle dimming are configured. Press play, or change them once in Settings.

Playback continues after you lock the phone, with artwork and controls on the Lock Screen. Set it face down and the sound stays.
